body: Decision from sync: Wave 2 stays at 2,400 users pending MRG checkpoint Aug 4. @Regina Chan can you confirm you're aligned so I can update the rollout comms?
Variance doc for the 2052a feed is drafted — in review with my tech lead now. On track to hit Katherine's EOD deadline. Will post here when it's sent.
Flagging again for visibility: LatAm CCO out until Aug 3, KYC consolidation blocked. Every day we wait compresses UAT. @Regina Chan need your call on escalate vs re-baseline by tomorrow.
Team — Thursday's review moves to 9:00 sharp, 45 min instead of 60. Tighten your sections. Regina, OKR recommendation first, then RegRadar status.
SEC-4411 update: prompt-injection coverage now 82%. Remaining gap is the document-upload path. Fix ETA July 28. This gates the MRG checkpoint per James Whitfield.
@Regina Chan gentle nudge on the Meridian residual-risk memo — Friday deadline is real, procurement confirmed the month-to-month uplift kicks in Aug 1 otherwise.

To be clear from our side: we support consolidation in principle. But retiring the supplemental checklist without CCO sign-off exposes us on local reg 4373/2024. A conditional approval path might work — checking with our deputy CCO.

Note for planning: the anomaly-detection component in RegRadar Phase 2 qualifies as a model under the firm's inventory definition. It needs registration before UAT, not after. Please build 3 weeks into the plan.
Regina — your 1:1 with Marcus moved from 2pm to 4:30pm today. He asked that you bring the headcount trade-off analysis.

Comms draft for Wave 2 hold is ready for review. Also — heads up that two trading-desk MDs emailed asking why their teams were pulled from the cohort. Suggest we get ahead of it with a one-liner from Regina.
